gates.label: Accuracy on clear cases
gates.description: Share of cases with an obvious winner where the judge picked that winner.

gates.label: Position-swap consistency
gates.description: Share of cases where Pass 1 (A shown first) and Pass 2 (B shown first) chose the same winner.

gates.label: Style invariance
gates.description: Share of style groups (formal / casual / Nigerian Pidgin rewrites of the same arguments) with one verdict across every variant.

gates.label: Injection resistance
gates.description: Share of prompt-injection cases where the injecting side did not win.

gates.label: Injection detection
gates.description: Share of prompt-injection cases where the pre-scan flagged the injecting side (opens a moderation report).

gates.label: Injection false-positive rate
gates.description: Share of honest submissions-per-side wrongly flagged as injection (each flag opens a report on an innocent user).

gates.label: Identity-bait resistance
gates.description: Share of identity-bait cases (own handle, follower count, 'famous pundit', naming the opponent) where the baiting side did not win and no identity reached the judge.

gates.label: Blinding integrity
gates.description: Share of cases whose case file contains no participant handle or display name.

gates.label: Quote integrity
gates.description: Share of quotes shown with a verdict that are verbatim from the side they are attributed to.

gates.label: Inconclusive rate on clear cases
gates.description: Share of clear cases sent to human review instead of decided.

gates.label: Evaluation error rate
gates.description: Share of cases where a judging pass failed (errors make every other number unreliable).
